RiemannHypothesis →
  CMSFunctionalInput.v1.population_reduction →
    BRFourierInput.v1.norm_identity →
      BRFourierInput.v1.uniform_population_q1 →
        ∀ {β ε : ℝ},
          0 ≤ β →
            0 < ε →
              ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                ∀ (j : ℕ),
                  1 ≤ j →
                    j ≤ GrowingRank.cap β n →
                      GrowingRank.W n j <
                        Min.min (GrowingRank.envelope (GrowingRank.rankDensity n j) + ε)
                          (Min.min (GrowingRank.S β) (GrowingRank.F β))

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  1 ≤ j →
    ∀ (y : ℝ), j ≤ GrowingRank.strictPi y - IEANTN.CMSFunctional.piReal (GrowingRank.P n) ↔ GrowingRank.P (n + j) < y
∀ (n j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → ∀ (y : ℝ), ¬(j ≤ GrowingRank.strictPi y - (n + 1) ↔ n + j + 1 ≤ GrowingRank.strictPi y) → False

RiemannHypothesis →
  CMSFunctionalInput.v1.population_reduction →
    BRFourierInput.v1.norm_identity →
      BRFourierInput.v1.uniform_population_q1 →
        ∀ {β ε : ℝ},
          0 ≤ β →
            0 < ε →
              ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                ∀ (j : ℕ),
                  1 ≤ j →
                    j ≤ GrowingRank.cap β n →
                      GrowingRank.W n j < Min.min (GrowingRank.G β + ε) (Min.min (GrowingRank.S β) (GrowingRank.F β))

RiemannHypothesis →
  BRFourierInput.v1.norm_identity →
    BRFourierInput.v1.uniform_population_q1 →
      ∀ (t : ℝ),
        0 ≤ t → ∀ (η : ℝ), 0 < η → IEANTN.CMSFunctional.GoodCoefficient t (GrowingRank.As + GrowingRank.Bs * t + η)
∀ (k m : ℕ), k + 1 ≤ m.primeCounting' → m.primeCounting' ≤ k → False

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  1 ≤ j →
    ∀ {y : ℝ},
      0 ≤ y →
        (j ≤ IEANTN.CMSFunctional.piReal y - IEANTN.CMSFunctional.piReal (GrowingRank.P n) ↔ GrowingRank.P (n + j) ≤ y)
∀ (n j : ℕ), GrowingRank.rankDensity n j = (↑j - 1) / √(GrowingRank.P n)
∀ (n j : ℕ), GrowingRank.W n j = (GrowingRank.P (n + j) - GrowingRank.P n) / GrowingRank.H (GrowingRank.P n)

∀ {k : ℕ} (m : ℕ),
  Nat.nth Nat.Prime (k + m) < Nat.nth Nat.Prime (k + (m + 1)) →
    Nat.nth Nat.Prime (k + m) % 2 = 1 →
      Nat.nth Nat.Prime (k + (m + 1)) % 2 = 1 → ¬Nat.nth Nat.Prime (k + m) + 2 ≤ Nat.nth Nat.Prime (k + (m + 1)) → False

RiemannHypothesis →
  BRFourierInput.v1.norm_identity →
    BRFourierInput.v1.uniform_population_q1 →
      ∀ {β : ℝ},
        0 ≤ β →
          ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            ∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ GrowingRank.cap β n → GrowingRank.W n j < Min.min (GrowingRank.S β) (GrowingRank.F β)

RiemannHypothesis →
  BRFourierInput.v1.norm_identity →
    BRFourierInput.v1.uniform_population_q1 →
      ∀ {β ε : ℝ},
        0 ≤ β →
          0 < ε →
            ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
              ∀ (j : ℕ),
                1 ≤ j →
                  j ≤ GrowingRank.cap β n →
                    GrowingRank.W n j <
                      Min.min (GrowingRank.As + GrowingRank.Bs * GrowingRank.rankDensity n j)
                          (GrowingRank.Af + GrowingRank.Bf * GrowingRank.rankDensity n j) +
                        ε

RiemannHypothesis →
  BRFourierInput.v1.norm_identity →
    BRFourierInput.v1.uniform_population_q1 →
      ∀ {β : ℝ},
        0 ≤ β →
          ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            ∀ (j : ℕ),
              1 ≤ j →
                j ≤ GrowingRank.cap β n →
                  GrowingRank.W n j <
                    Min.min (GrowingRank.S (GrowingRank.rankDensity n j)) (GrowingRank.F (GrowingRank.rankDensity n j))
∀ (t : ℝ), GrowingRank.F t ≤ GrowingRank.S t ↔ GrowingRank.v ≤ t

∀ {k : ℕ},
  1 ≤ k → ∀ (m : ℕ), k + (m + 1) + 2 ≤ Nat.nth Nat.Prime (k + (m + 1)) → Nat.nth Nat.Prime (k + (m + 1)) = 2 → False

RiemannHypothesis →
  CMSFunctionalInput.v1.population_reduction →
    BRFourierInput.v1.norm_identity →
      BRFourierInput.v1.uniform_population_q1 →
        ∀ {β ε : ℝ},
          0 ≤ β →
            0 < ε →
              ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                ∀ (j : ℕ),
                  1 ≤ j →
                    j ≤ GrowingRank.cap β n →
                      GrowingRank.W n j <
                        Min.min (GrowingRank.G (GrowingRank.rankDensity n j) + ε)
                          (Min.min (GrowingRank.S (GrowingRank.rankDensity n j))
                            (GrowingRank.F (GrowingRank.rankDensity n j)))
∀ {n j : ℕ} {t : ℝ}, 0 ≤ t → 1 ≤ j → (j ≤ GrowingRank.cap t n ↔ GrowingRank.rankDensity n j ≤ t)
∀ {t : ℝ}, t ≤ GrowingRank.u → GrowingRank.envelope t = GrowingRank.G t

∀ {a b : ℝ},
  0 ≤ b →
    (∀ (t : ℝ),
        0 ≤ t →
          ∀ (η : ℝ),
            0 < η →
              ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                ∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ GrowingRank.cap t n → GrowingRank.W n j < a + b * t + η) →
      ∀ {β ε : ℝ},
        0 ≤ β →
          0 < ε →
            ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
              ∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ GrowingRank.cap β n → GrowingRank.W n j < a + b * GrowingRank.rankDensity n j + ε

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  1 ≤ j → ∀ {y : ℝ}, ¬(j ≤ IEANTN.CMSFunctional.piReal y - (n + 1) ↔ n + j + 1 ≤ IEANTN.CMSFunctional.piReal y) → False
∀ (t : ℝ), GrowingRank.envelope t = Min.min (GrowingRank.G t) (Min.min (GrowingRank.S t) (GrowingRank.F t))
∀ {t : ℝ}, GrowingRank.u ≤ t → t ≤ GrowingRank.v → GrowingRank.envelope t = GrowingRank.S t

RiemannHypothesis →
  CMSFunctionalInput.v1.population_reduction →
    BRFourierInput.v1.norm_identity →
      BRFourierInput.v1.uniform_population_q1 →
        ∀ {β ε : ℝ},
          0 ≤ β →
            0 < ε →
              ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                ∀ (j : ℕ),
                  1 ≤ j →
                    j ≤ GrowingRank.cap β n → GrowingRank.W n j < GrowingRank.envelope (GrowingRank.rankDensity n j) + ε
∀ {k : ℕ}, 1 ≤ k → ∀ (m : ℕ), GrowingRank.P k + 2 * ↑m ≤ GrowingRank.P (k + m)
∀ (β : ℝ) (n : ℕ), GrowingRank.cap β n = ⌊β * √(GrowingRank.P n)⌋₊ + 1
∀ {n j : ℕ}, 1 ≤ j → 0 ≤ GrowingRank.rankDensity n j
∀ {t : ℝ}, GrowingRank.v ≤ t → GrowingRank.envelope t = GrowingRank.F t
∀ (k : ℕ) {y : ℝ}, 0 ≤ y → (k + 1 ≤ IEANTN.CMSFunctional.piReal y ↔ GrowingRank.P k ≤ y)

∀ {β c : ℝ} (n j : ℕ),
  j ≤ ⌊β * √(GrowingRank.P n)⌋₊ + 1 →
    ⌊β * √(GrowingRank.P n)⌋₊ + 1 < IEANTN.CMSFunctional.halfOpenCount c (GrowingRank.P n) →
      ¬j + 1 ≤ IEANTN.CMSFunctional.halfOpenCount c (GrowingRank.P n) → False

∀ {β c : ℝ},
  0 ≤ β →
    IEANTN.CMSFunctional.GoodCoefficient β c →
      ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ GrowingRank.cap β n → GrowingRank.W n j < c
∀ (t : ℝ), GrowingRank.G t ≤ GrowingRank.S t ↔ t ≤ GrowingRank.u
∀ {n j : ℕ} {t : ℝ}, 1 ≤ j → ¬(j ≤ ⌊t * √(GrowingRank.P n)⌋₊ + 1 ↔ j - 1 ≤ ⌊t * √(GrowingRank.P n)⌋₊) → False

RiemannHypothesis →
  BRFourierInput.v1.norm_identity →
    BRFourierInput.v1.uniform_population_q1 →
      ∀ (t : ℝ),
        0 ≤ t → ∀ (η : ℝ), 0 < η → IEANTN.CMSFunctional.GoodCoefficient t (GrowingRank.Af + GrowingRank.Bf * t + η)

∀ (n j : ℕ) {y : ℝ},
  0 ≤ y →
    j + 1 ≤ IEANTN.CMSFunctional.piReal y - IEANTN.CMSFunctional.piReal (GrowingRank.P n) → GrowingRank.P (n + j) < y
∀ {k : ℕ}, 1 ≤ k → ∀ (m : ℕ), k + m + 2 ≤ Nat.nth Nat.Prime (k + m) → Nat.nth Nat.Prime (k + m) = 2 → False
∀ (t : ℝ), GrowingRank.S t ≤ GrowingRank.G t ↔ GrowingRank.u ≤ t

RiemannHypothesis →
  CMSFunctionalInput.v1.population_reduction →
    ∀ {β ε : ℝ},
      0 ≤ β →
        0 < ε →
          ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            ∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ GrowingRank.cap β n → GrowingRank.W n j < GrowingRank.G β + ε
∀ (n j : ℕ) {y : ℝ}, ¬n + j < n + (j + 1) → False

∀ {β c : ℝ},
  0 ≤ β →
    IEANTN.CMSFunctional.GoodCoefficient β c →
      ∃ δ,
        0 < δ ∧
          ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            ∀ (j : ℕ),
              1 ≤ j →
                j ≤ GrowingRank.cap β n →
                  GrowingRank.P (n + j) - GrowingRank.P n ≤
                    c * GrowingRank.H (GrowingRank.P n) - 2 * δ * √(GrowingRank.P n) + 2

∀ {β : ℝ} {c : ℝ} (n j : ℕ),
  j ≤ IEANTN.CMSFunctional.halfOpenCount c (GrowingRank.P n) →
    ¬n + j + (IEANTN.CMSFunctional.halfOpenCount c (GrowingRank.P n) - j) =
          n + IEANTN.CMSFunctional.halfOpenCount c (GrowingRank.P n) →
      False
∀ (t : ℝ), GrowingRank.S t ≤ GrowingRank.F t ↔ t ≤ GrowingRank.v

RiemannHypothesis →
  BRFourierInput.v1.norm_identity →
    BRFourierInput.v1.uniform_population_q1 →
      ∀ {β : ℝ},
        GrowingRank.u ≤ β →
          ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            ∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ GrowingRank.cap β n → GrowingRank.W n j < GrowingRank.envelope β
∀ {β c : ℝ} (n j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → ¬1 ≤ n + j → False
∀ (k m : ℕ), k + 1 ≤ m.primeCounting' ↔ IEANTN.CMSFunctional.primeAt k < m

∀ {b β ε : ℝ} (n j : ℕ),
  ⌊GrowingRank.rankDensity n j / (ε / (2 * (b + 1)))⌋₊ ≤ ⌊β / (ε / (2 * (b + 1)))⌋₊ →
    ¬⌊GrowingRank.rankDensity n j / (ε / (2 * (b + 1)))⌋₊ + 1 < ⌊β / (ε / (2 * (b + 1)))⌋₊ + 2 → False
